_doc: Hawking on the street map (systems/falconry.js rules; ui/innerMapHawk.js the flight). Your hawk rides your gloved fist; right-click a small wild beast or bird within range and fly it. chance = quarry.base + training (0..1: bond and kills, killsToMaster) x trainWeight + huntRank (the Hunting & Butchering rank, 0..4) x perHuntRank - perTile beyond freeTiles, times the breed's mult for the quarry's class (ground / fowl), the weather's mult (out in the open), the hawk's fitness (bond, belly, health; an eyas half) and a sated hawk's lazier flight (hunger above satedAbove: satedMult); clamped to [minChance, maxChance]. rake: the chance it goes off on its own at the launch and takes stand in a tree (base + untrained x (1 - training) + hungry when its belly is under hungryBelow + young for an eyas, times (1 - kills/killsToMaster x steadied)); lured back with meat from your packs (lure: base + perBond x bond/100 + hungry when its belly is under 50; the meat is only taken when it comes); left raked when you leave the map, it finds you again by nightfall, bond down leftBond. reward: what it is given off a kill you take from it (hunger, bond); feedUp: what it eats when you leave it on the kill feedUpSeconds (the kill is then eaten, nothing left to butcher). daily: the day you flew it, its own hunting for itself (species forage) is cut to fedForage once fed off a kill, else flownForage, and its share in the hunt's small game (huntQty) is off that day: no double-dipping. Times are seconds of the street map's clock, distances tiles.

lines.launch: You cast {name} off the fist at the {quarry}.
lines.kill: {name} binds to the {quarry} and mantles over it. Walk up and take it.
lines.miss: {name} stoops and misses: the {quarry} bolts. {name} throws up and comes back.
lines.rake: {name} rakes away from the {quarry} and takes stand in a tree. Lure it down with meat.
lines.taken: You take the {quarry} from {name} and reward it with the head and neck.
lines.fedUp: Left on the kill, {name} has fed up on the {quarry}: nothing worth butchering is left.
lines.lured: {name} drops out of the tree onto the lure on your fist.
lines.lureFail: {name} eyes the meat from its branch, and stays where it is.
lines.leftRaked: {name} found you again by nightfall, hungry and wild.
